missions.phrase: В его голосе была сильная обида.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Обида' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'была'. 'Сильная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в его голосе' gives the location. A clean emotional card.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу копить старую обиду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Обиду' is the accusative direct object of 'копить'. 'Старую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'не хочу' frames the intention. A natural emotional pattern.

missions.phrase: В её словах не было обиды.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Обиды' takes the genitive after 'не было' to mark non-existence. 'В её словах' sets the context. A standard negation frame.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'из-за'. 'Обиды' takes the genitive after the causal 'из-за' to mean because of resentment. 'Он перестал звонить' is the result. A common cause pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner with 'с'. 'С обидой' uses the instrumental 'обидой' to express the manner of feeling. 'Глубокой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A useful expressive frame.

missions.phrase: Мы долго говорили об этой обиде.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об обиде' uses the prepositional 'обиде' after 'об' to express talking about the feeling. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, and 'долго' adds duration.

Strategic focus: Accusative object with dative recipient. 'Обиду' is the accusative direct object of 'простила'. 'Другу' is the dative of the person forgiven, and 'его' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Обиды' is the nominative plural subject of 'мешают'. 'Старые' agrees in the plural, and 'нам' is the dative of the affected people. A clean plural model.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Обиды' is the accusative plural of an inanimate noun, the object of 'забыть'. 'Все детские' agrees in the plural. Strong for reflective language.

missions.phrase: Дети быстро забывают о своих обидах.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Об обидах' uses the prepositional plural 'обидах' after 'о' to mean about their grievances. 'Своих' agrees in the plural. A useful pattern for habits.
